# Sync Requirements Checklist: Sync Heads Adoption (client)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of spec 011 — skipping wallets safely with the heads (no missed change, no wrong removal), position integrity, partners' names, the restore pair's parity with the per-record two-step, the kept purge safeguard, and contract fidelity
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Focus (assumed default, owner away): correctness risks of skipping reads and of moving the restore into the batch, then contract fidelity; standard depth; audience = PR reviewer. Items found as gaps were fixed in the spec, plan or research in the same session; each says where. Unchecked items were reviewed and hold; they stay open for the PR reviewer.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is it specified whether the heads are read when the person's own changes failed (not offline)? [Gap → fixed: FR-004 last sentence]
- [x] CHK002 Is the behaviour of an edit made while a restore pair is in flight specified? [Gap → fixed: FR-015 last sentence, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK003 Is it stated that the background upload job does not use the heads? [Gap → fixed: Edge Cases; FR-007 written-to wallets]
- [x] CHK004 Is per-item logging of the pair specified? [Gap → fixed: FR-015 (spec 009 FR-030 applies to both items)]
- [ ] CHK005 Is every row of the backend's heads table mapped to a client rule, including "listed, no stored position" and "not listed"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, contracts/sync-heads-client.md]
- [ ] CHK006 Is every heads answer (200, empty, undecodable, each 400 code, 401, 406, 426, 429, 5xx, offline, timeout) assigned an outcome? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, contracts table]
- [ ] CHK007 Are all callers that forget a stored place covered by "forget the position too" (410, invalid cursor, access lost, discard of a wallet change, later migrations, sign-out)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, data-model §1, research R-02]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the refresh kinds that bypass the heads enumerated (single wallet, carry settling, named "Use the other device's", written-to, unconfirmed, placeless, not accepted)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, research R-03]
- [ ] CHK009 Are all screens showing member names named for FR-013? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, research R-08]
- [ ] CHK010 Are all four restore-pair answer combinations specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, contracts pair table]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK011 Is the decision order explicit when both "purge horizon > p" and "head > p" hold? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005 order, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "equal" vs "greater" unambiguous at the boundary `purged_change_seq == p`? [Clarity, Edge Cases, research R-04]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "Updated …" for a skipped wallet defined with a concrete instant? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, research R-06]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "never split across requests" quantified at the 50-item boundary? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, SC-005]
- [x] CHK015 Is SC-001's baseline ("read once") clear about the first run after the update? [Ambiguity → fixed: SC-001 "read once by this version"; SC-007; research R-12]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK016 Is FR-005 rule 3 consistent with spec 009 FR-007/FR-008 (copy kept, sweep, waiting changes kept)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, research R-07]
- [ ] CHK017 Is FR-008 (heads never remove) consistent with spec 009 FR-011 (only 404 or ended membership removes)? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK018 Is FR-015's "restore applied, save refused" outcome consistent with today's per-record `restoreThenSave`? [Consistency, Clarification 3, research R-09]
- [ ] CHK019 Is FR-019 consistent with the user input ("keep the once-per-run safeguard otherwise") and spec 009 implementation note 20? [Consistency, Clarification 5, research R-11]
- [ ] CHK020 Do FR-001/FR-003 respect the contract's "never parse, compare or construct a cursor" and ADR-0021's rejected "compare with the record's change_seq"? [Consistency, research R-01]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK021 Are SC-001/SC-002 request counts measurable in host tests (fake API call counts) and live QA? [Measurability, plan Testing, quickstart §2]
- [ ] CHK022 Does every §4 invariant name a test? [Traceability, Spec §4, research R-14]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are race windows covered: a write between heads and wallet read, a purge between heads and read, a membership gained between user read and heads? [Coverage, Edge Cases, research R-04/R-07]
- [ ] CHK024 Is a person in more than 200 wallets covered (paged heads, failure on page 2)? [Coverage, Edge Cases, FR-009, FR-010]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the replay of a lost restore pair covered with a proof plan? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017, §9, research R-10, quickstart §2]
- [ ] CHK026 Is a pair whose transaction depends on an unaccepted wallet or category covered? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014 held dependents, Edge Cases]
